claims.claim: The original base generates unbacked Texture metadata, iPhone19,2 and an Apple MakerNote from the synthetic no-capture test input. The refusal regression fails at its explicit assertion on that base.

The safe research API preserves an existing locally addressable opaque Texture carrier byte for byte, including media, gain, color, orientation and unrelated bytes. This is transport, not native conformance.

The ordinary Photographic Styles path uses v15 without fixed2026 augmentation. Native Rust/Swift build passes, but four generated inputs fail at dimg/tmap before final assembly; batch was not reached. This path is not functionally complete.

The 2023 styles URI v16 payload and the separate 2026 texture_styles URI are different objects. Shader unit results from prior PSR research do not establish a complete native producer or Photos activation.

Native macOS27 Texture parser returns properties for Standard,Studio,missingHardware and version999 metadata controls; empty dictionary is nil NUError3. macOS26 lacks the class. No whole-image admission or original provenance is established.
Twelve CC0 chart JPEG/HEIC/SDR/PQ/AdaptiveHDR native writes and decodes succeeded. This is not Texture parsing, rendering, pixel-fidelity certification or Photos activation.
Real camera Texture positive reproduction, original per-person context and iPhone Photos UI/editability were not executed. No private sample, vendor binary, secret or photo was uploaded in this work.

Native configuration has13 input names including hairMatte. Required/optional channels vary by effect; Bloom empty requirements do not imply a single-image kernel contract. Settings factories accept no image.

Original Bloom apply returns delayed CIImage but all tested intensities abort during real render. Source-derived2023 semantic diagnostic is accepted, advancing the assertion from Missing arguments to Unexpected number of inputs. CMI initialization is nil and _textureCache assertion observed; hardware impossibility is not established.
Twenty-one actual complete job logs were read.147 native JSON payloads from18 jobs match their runner manifests in exact size/SHA. Inaccessible ZIP bytes are unverified.

After interruption, selected environment remains starting and exec reports no usable environment. Previous local uncommitted file state was not inspected or overwritten. Remote XD0a462134 and PSR84f2c830 were verified before remote evidence recovery.
